name: Movement reservation
summary: Schedule an ordered route with per-leg speed, altitude or depth, and optional rules of engagement on arrival. Repeating routes can start after a one-time approach.
requirements: Requires Data for AI access to own units and movement plans. The target must be controllable and mobile; aircraft must be airborne. Settings must be among the target's available options. The first reservation update may switch a follower to independent action.
proposal_followers: {0}: following units will move with the leader.
proposal_arrival_rules_scope: {0}: arrival ROE may also apply to other formation members (including those acting independently), depending on formation-control settings.
